title: VocalAgent: Large Language Models for Vocal Health Diagnostics with Safety-Aware Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Assessing classification performance by measuring false positive rates (FPR) and analyzing confusion matrices to determine if the model's predictions are disproportionately skewed towards specific voice disorder classes.

Evaluating cross-lingual generalizability by comparing the model's accuracy and macro-F1 scores on voice disorder datasets across different languages (Korean, English, and Portuguese) to see how well the model performs on languages it was not trained on.
